description: Turn any TOP into a character-grid ASCII render: quantise input luminance into a (W/cell × H/cell) grid, then look up each glyph from a monospace character atlas. Supports mono, source-color (per-cell tint), and two-color (lerp by luminance) modes. Phosphor-green default for the Severance / CRT terminal look. Creates a resolutionTOP (cells), textTOP (atlas), glslTOP, and nullTOP output inside a new baseCOMP. Exposes Mix, CellSize, and Charset controls.

bg_color.description: Background colour [r,g,b] 0–1. Used in all modes.

cell_size.description: Pixel size of each character cell. min 4, max 64.

charset.description: Dark→light glyph ramp. Min 2 chars, max 32. Leading spaces add more 'black' room.

color_mode.description: mono: fixed fg on bg; source-color: per-cell average tint; two-color: lerp(bg,fg) by luminance.

fg_color.description: Foreground glyph colour [r,g,b] 0–1. Phosphor-green default. Used in mono/two-color.

font.description: Monospace font fed to the atlas textTOP.

mix.description: Blend between original (0) and ASCII output (1). Live-tweakable.

name.description: Base name for the created container.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the ASCII render container is created inside.

source.description: Absolute path of an existing TOP to render as ASCII (e.g. '/project1/movie1'). If omitted, a self-contained animated colour-noise source is used (no device permissions).

name: create_ascii_render
title: Create ASCII render
